{{short description|British mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''David Eric Edmunds [[Learned Society of Wales|FLSW]]''' is a British mathematician working in analysis.

He obtained his PhD in 1955 at the [[University of Cardiff]] under the supervision of [[Rosa M. Morris]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=27015|title = David Edmunds - the Mathematics Genealogy Project}}</ref>

In 1996, he was awarded the [[Pólya Prize (LMS)|Pólya Prize]] of the [[London Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lms.ac.uk/prizes/list-lms-prize-winners|title = List of LMS prize winners &#124; London Mathematical Society}}</ref>

In 2011, he was elected a [[Learned Society of Wales|Fellow of the Learned Society of Wales]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Wales |first=The Learned Society of |title=David Edmunds |url=https://www.learnedsociety.wales/fellow/david-edmunds/ |access-date=2023-08-30 |website=The Learned Society of Wales |language=en-US}}</ref>

[[John M. Ball]] was one of his PhD students.
